WITH purpose_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(k_symbol, '') AS k_symbol,
        AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM `order`
    WHERE amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY COALESCE(k_symbol, '')
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_average
    FROM purpose_avgs
)
SELECT 
    pa.k_symbol,
    pa.avg_amount,
    pa.avg_amount - oa.overall_average AS exceeds
FROM purpose_avgs pa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE pa.avg_amount > oa.overall_average
ORDER BY pa.k_symbol
